name: Securing the Lines
summary: Near Razorwind Canyon, Rezlak needs the goblin supply routes through Durotar protected. Harpies in Drygulch Ravine keep intercepting and plundering caravans, so he hires help to drive them out.

sections.title: A Route Plagued by Harpies
sections.body: Dustwind harpies make travel through Durotar’s dry valleys dangerous. Rezlak watches over regional supply operations for his boss, Gazlowe. The harpies roosting in Drygulch Ravine raid caravans in Razorwind Canyon and seize shipments before they reach their destinations.

sections.title: Business and Bloodshed
sections.body: Rezlak believes the right price can get anything done. Rather than enter the canyon himself, he hires adventurers to break the roost by eliminating Dustwind Savages and Dustwind Storm Witches. Clearing the harpies keeps trade corridors open, secures shipments of engineering gadgets, and points helpful travelers toward greater opportunities in Ratchet.

faq.answer: Rezlak works for Gazlowe, chief engineer and boss of Ratchet, the neutral goblin port town. Gazlowe oversees extensive commerce and infrastructure projects throughout Durotar and the Barrens.

faq.q: Why are the harpies attacking caravans?
faq.answer: The Dustwind harpies roost in Drygulch Ravine, which runs alongside Razorwind Canyon’s main transit routes. They attack intruders and plunder nearby wagons and goods.
Drygulch Ravine lies deep in the eastern reaches of Razorwind Canyon in northern Durotar, carved into the arid crimson hills.

Once the Dustwind harpies are culled and the supply route is secure, Rezlak points adventurers across the border to Ratchet in the Barrens. He encourages them to seek out Gazlowe for more profitable contracts.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Horde handle the harpies instead of goblins?
faq.answer: The Horde has outposts in Durotar, but its resources are stretched thin by centaur, quilboar, and the needs of its settlements. Goblin merchants like Rezlak often find it quicker and cheaper to hire independent adventurers to protect their private enterprise.

faq.q: What kinds of harpies reside in Drygulch Ravine?
faq.answer: Drygulch Ravine’s roost includes feral Dustwind Savages, who attack at close range, and Dustwind Storm Witches, who wield wind and lightning against trespassing caravans.

angles.text: Keeping Rezlak’s shipments safe helps goblin components move from Ratchet into the hands of local tinkerers.
Clearing the harpies in eastern Razorwind Canyon keeps goods and reinforcements moving between Durotar’s frontier outposts and coastal trade hubs.
